senses.gloss: f. ch. same, esp. examination of slaughtered animals as to the condition of the lungs &c., v. בְּדַק.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 48a:4">Ḥull. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>לית להו ב׳ וכ׳</he> no examination will avail them to make them permitted; (ib. 46ᵃ <he>לית להו בדיקה</he>). Ib. 10ᵇ <he>מצריך ב׳ וכ׳</he> declares an examination (of the slaughtering knife) necessary &c.; a. e.
